The dashboard at [**`/workspace/index.html`**](file:///workspace/index.html) has been updated to **show only the years 2021 to 2023**.

### What has been updated:
1. **Year Selector**: Now displays quick selection pills exclusively for **`Year 2021`**, **`Year 2022`**, and **`Year 2023`**.
2. **Trend Analytics**: The multi-year trajectory chart now visualizes district coverage progression across **2021 – 2023**.
